quote: In mouse models of acute and chronic colitis, oral administration of Elafin-expressing LAB decreased elastolytic activity and inflammation and restored intestinal homeostasis.
summary: Elafin mucosal expression is reduced in IBD; delivering elafin via engineered lactic acid bacteria reduced inflammation in mouse colitis and protected inflamed human epithelial cells from permeability and cytokine release.
PI3 here means type III PI3 kinase in autophagy, not the elafin gene PI3.
ESI here means electrospray ionization mass spectrometry in a bacterial epidemiology paper, not the PI3 gene.
ESI here means electrospray ionization mass spectrometry of mucus phospholipids, not the PI3 gene.

quote: We have collated and selectively reviewed data on the most prominent well-established and emerging neutrophil-related biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets (calprotectin, lactoferrin, CXCR1, CXCR2, MMP-9, NGAL, elafin, HNE, pANCAs, MPO, CD16, CD177, CD64, HNPs, SLPI and PTX3) in ulcerative colitis.
summary: Review of neutrophil biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets in ulcerative colitis that includes elafin among many others, without new data.
ESI here means electrospray ionization mass spectrometry in a gluten degradation study, not the PI3 gene.
ESI here means electrospray ionization mass spectrometry of mucus phosphatidylcholine, not the PI3 gene.
ESI here means electrospray ionization mass spectrometry of plasma lipids in obesity, not the PI3 gene.
PI3 here refers to PI3-kinase in glucocorticoid osteoporosis, not the elafin gene.

quote: As compared with ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease of the colon is characterized by an impaired induction of beta defensins, and antimicrobial antiproteases elafin and SLPI, as well as the cathelicidin LL37.
summary: Review noting that induction of elafin is impaired in colonic Crohn's disease compared with ulcerative colitis, among other antimicrobial peptide defects.
ESI here is the Epac inhibitor ESI-09 in inflammatory pain, not the PI3 gene.
ESI here means electrospray ionization in glycopeptide mass spectrometry, not the PI3 gene.

quote: Our finding of cystatin C, elafin and fetuin-A as substrates and natural inhibitors for meprins reveal new mechanisms in the regulation of protease activity important for understanding pathophysiological processes.
summary: Elafin is identified as a substrate and natural inhibitor of meprin metalloproteases in a degradome screen; no colitis data.
PI3 here refers to PI3 kinase signaling downstream of IL-6, not the elafin gene.

quote: In mice given TNBS or DSS, transgenic expression of elafin or disruption of NE and PR-3 protected against the development of colitis.
summary: Transgenic expression or adenoviral delivery of elafin protected mice from TNBS and DSS colitis, reduced inflammatory mediators and strengthened epithelial barrier function.
ESI-MS here means electrospray ionization mass spectrometry in an osteosarcoma study, not the PI3 gene.

quote: CXCR3 is activated by three interferon-inducible ligands CXCL9 (MIG), CXCL10 (IP-10) and CXCL11 (I-TAC).
summary: Review of CXCR3 in T cell trafficking; CXCL11 is mentioned only as one of three CXCR3 ligands.

quote: CXCR3 is activated by three interferon (IFN)-γ-inducible ligands CXCL9 (monokine induced by gamma-interferon), CXCL10 (interferon-induced protein-10) and CXCL11 (interferon-inducible T-cell alpha chemoattractant).
summary: Review of redundant, collaborative and antagonistic functions of CXCR3 ligands including CXCL11 in T cell trafficking; no UC data.

quote: Lastly, LPS-induced sepsis is exacerbated in LysMCre-SOCS3(fl/fl) mice and is associated with enhanced STAT1/3 activation and increased plasma levels of M1 cytokines/chemokines such as IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6, CCL3, CCL4, and CXCL11.
summary: CXCL11 is one of several cytokines raised in plasma of SOCS3-deficient mice in LPS sepsis; the paper studies SOCS3, not CXCL11.

quote: An Ingenuity pathway analysis based on the differentially expressed genes suggested that propionate and butyrate modulate leukocyte trafficking, as SCFA strongly reduced the release of several pro-inflammatory chemokines including CCL3, CCL4, CCL5, CXCL9, CXCL10, and CXCL11.
summary: Short-chain fatty acids reduced release of several chemokines including CXCL11 from human monocyte-derived dendritic cells; CXCL11 itself was not perturbed.

quote: The inflammatory chemokines CXCL9, CXCL10, and CXCL11 are predominantly induced by interferon (IFN)-γ and share an exclusive chemokine receptor named CXC chemokine receptor 3 (CXCR3).
summary: Review of molecular properties and non-redundant in vivo activities of the interferon-inducible CXCR3 ligands including CXCL11.

quote: Both IP-10 and Mig, as well as the IFN-gamma-inducible T-cell alpha chemoattractant (I-TAC), which all share high-affinity binding for CXCR3, block HMVEC proliferation in vitro, an effect that can be inhibited by an anti-CXCR3 antibody.
summary: I-TAC (CXCL11) blocks proliferation of human microvascular endothelial cells via CXCR3 in vitro, an angiostatic effect; no inflammation or colitis outcome was measured.

quote: We found a significant increase in an array of chemokines including macrophage migration factor (MIF), CCL25, CCL23, CXCL5, CXCL13, CXCL10, CXCL11, MCP1, and CCL21 in IBD patients as compared to normal healthy donors (P<0.05).
summary: Circulating CXCL11 was significantly higher in IBD patients than in healthy donors, among several raised chemokines.

quote: Likewise, strategies which affect Treg migration involve chemokines CCL17 and CXCL11.
summary: Review of regulatory T cells in multiple sclerosis and myasthenia gravis that mentions CXCL11 as affecting Treg migration; no UC content.

quote: Later we showed that CXCL11 directs the linage development of T-regulatory-1 cells (Tr1).
summary: Mini review of CXCR3 ligands in cancer and autoimmunity, noting CXCL11 binds CXCR3 with higher affinity and drives Tr1 cell development.
